configuration.parameterization: mu=a/(1-b), prior specified directly on mu and b

moment_audits.proof: The direct Gaussian prior on the long-run mean has finite polynomial moments; |1-b|<2 bounds the induced intercept, and the bounded stationary log-volatility variance preserves finite-horizon predictive moments.
moment_audits.prior_prediction_caveat: The log-variance prior SD is 1; finite moments do not by themselves establish good prior calibration.
